About This Auction

A property rarely checks all the boxes when it comes to land uses, this place does just that with a mix of tillable, timber, and grass. This Cowley County acreage will be offered by online auction September 8th-10th.  It is 74.5 acres and sits just east of Winfield and south of Burden off of 160 Highway. The land will lay east and west with road frontage off 201st road on the west side. It has approximately 49 acres of farm ground that was last planted to wheat. It has been cash rented by a farmer in the past few years who also has been putting up the hay. A trail running along the fields edge will lead you back to a hay meadow lying on the south east side of the property. It is very secluded and will offer some excellent deer, turkey, and upland bird hunting. This area also has a pond providing a water source for livestock or wildlife. The whole property has a perimeter hedge row making good funnels and travel corridors for deer movement. Along the road runs electric and rural water allowing easy access to utilities.  7.5 miles to Burden KS 10 miles to Winfield KS 55 miles to Wichita KS 124 miles to Tulsa OK   It is hard to find ground with this much versatility, especially in the area its in. Dont miss your chance to bid on September 10th!  If you have any questions about the property or auction process reach out to Clint Graves at (620)440-2683 or email at cgraves@L2realtyinc.com.
